reason: I can wire up n8n with a ChatGPT vision node to dump receipts into a Google Sheet over a weekend, and my volume of nota isn't big enough to pay $19 a month forever for something I could own. I'd try the 40 free ones out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay.
objection: It's a wrapper around stuff I can build myself for a few dollars of API calls, and I'm not convinced it reads my staff's messy handwritten Indonesian nota any better than ChatGPT does.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial showed it really nails the handwritten nota and catches duplicates my own bot would miss, and the price was closer to $5-10 a month for my volume.
